::: {.wm-bio}
I study stochastic problems in Number Theory and Cryptography, particularly related to supersingular elliptic curves and quaternion algebras.
:::

[News]{.wm-box-label}

- [Oct 2026]{.wm-news-date} New preprint: [*Generating Sets for Maximal Orders in Rational Quaternion Algebras*](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10139).
- [Fall 2026]{.wm-news-date} Teaching MATH 1214: Preparation for Calculus at Virginia Tech.
